summary: Describes a set of multicast communication primitives combined with a way to handle process failure and recovery. They help build fault-tolerant process groups, which provide distributed services even when machines crash, as long as the failures are not malicious.

eli5.summary: If one worker in a team gets sick, the others keep going and everyone still agrees on what has happened. This memo describes tools to make computer teams work that way.

questions: how to build fault tolerant process groups
what are multicast primitives for process failure
